# Security

AutoERP runs inside your logged-in ERP session, so a bug in it can reach your ERP account. If you find one that could leak data, submit a form you did not mean to submit or run code ERP did not send, please don't open a public issue. Reach me through [ashuwhy.com](https://ashuwhy.com) with the steps to reproduce it, and leave out your roll number and password.

I'll reply within a week. Once a fixed version is out you're free to publish the details, and if you want credit in the changelog, say so.

Only the latest release gets fixes.
